article.title: Defending Democratic Institutions w/Stacey Abrams
article.author: Scot Nakagawa
article.content: The Supreme Court gutted the Voting Rights Act. The midterms are near. This is not a normal political moment and it calls for more than a normal political response. In this episode, Scot talks with Stacey Abrams, voting rights champion, political leader, and founder of Fair Fight Action, about her ten-point plan to defeat authoritarianism, what it means to defend democratic institutions when those… Source
